proved: The affine branch and its finite pointwise minimum are absolutely continuous on uIcc a b.
The minimum, every branch, the vector path, and every coordinate are differentiable almost everywhere on uIcc a b, derived from interval absolute continuity.
At every time where the path and minimum are differentiable, every weakly active branch has derivative sum_j coeff(i,j) * deriv(x_j,t), equal to the minimum derivative.
If every weakly active branch has derivative at least delta almost everywhere, then the minimum derivative is at least delta almost everywhere.
tie_semantics: All weak minimizers are quantified universally; finite attainment is used only to obtain one active branch for the drift corollary.
scope_limits: This formalizes the finite affine lower-envelope Caratheodory bridge only.
It does not formalize the remaining global N33 permanence argument or establish external mathematical validation.
